theme: 教材片語・進階 650–750 第 4 群

items.colloc: obtain a parking pass 取得停車證 | display the parking pass 出示停車證
items.distinct: parking permit 停車許可證 | parking space 停車位
ex: Employees must display their parking pass at all times.
員工必須隨時展示他們的停車證。
Please show your parking pass to the security guard.
請向警衛出示您的停車證。
New parking passes will be distributed starting next Monday.
新的停車證將從下週一開始發放。

items.colloc: press the button firmly 用力按下按鈕 | press the button twice 按兩下按鈕
items.distinct: push the button 推動按鈕 | click the button 點擊按鈕（滑鼠）
ex: You need to press the button to open the gate.
你需要按下按鈕才能打開大門。
Simply press the button to start the printing process.
只需按下按鈕即可開始列印程序。
She had to press the button to alert the floor manager.
她必須按下按鈕來通知樓層經理。

items.colloc: visit a public park 參觀公園 | maintain a public park 維護公園
items.distinct: private garden 私人庭院 | national park 國家公園
ex: The city plans to renovate the old public park downtown.
市政府計畫翻修市中心的老舊公園。
They held the company picnic at a nearby public park.
他們在附近的公園舉辦了公司野餐。
This public park is open to all residents until sunset.
這座公園對所有居民開放至日落。

items.colloc: contact the public relations department 聯繫公關部 | head of the public relations department 公關部主管
items.distinct: human resources department 人力資源部 | marketing department 行銷部
ex: Direct all media inquiries to our public relations department.
將所有媒體詢問轉交給我們的公關部。
The public relations department released a formal statement today.
公關部今天發布了一份正式聲明。
She works as a manager in the public relations department.
她在公關部擔任經理。

items.colloc: put on a coat 穿上外套 | put on a show 上演節目
items.distinct: wear 穿著（狀態） | try on 試穿
ex: Please put on your safety goggles before entering the lab.
進入實驗室前請戴上護目鏡。
The team will put on a presentation for the clients.
團隊將為客戶進行一場簡報演示。
She needs to put on a professional suit for the interview.
她需要穿上一套專業套裝去面試。

items.colloc: analyze sales trends 分析銷售趨勢 | rising sales trend 上升的銷售趨勢
items.distinct: sales figure 銷售數字 | market trend 市場趨勢
ex: The report highlights a positive sales trend this quarter.
該報告強調了本季正向的銷售趨勢。
We must carefully examine the latest sales trend reports.
我們必須仔細檢視最新的銷售趨勢報告。
The recent sales trend indicates a decline in demand.
近期的銷售趨勢顯示需求有所下滑。

items.colloc: designated smoking section 指定吸菸區 | locate the smoking section 找到吸菸區
items.distinct: non-smoking area 非吸菸區 | lounge 休息室
ex: The restaurant provides a separate smoking section outdoors.
餐廳在戶外設有獨立的吸菸區。
Guests are required to use the designated smoking section.
客人必須使用指定的吸菸區。
Smoking is strictly prohibited outside the smoking section.
在吸菸區外嚴禁吸菸。

items.colloc: switch off the lights 關燈 | switch off the equipment 關閉設備
items.distinct: turn off 關掉 | power down 關機
ex: Remember to switch off your computer before leaving the office.
離開辦公室前記得關掉電腦。
Please switch off all electronic devices during the flight.
飛行期間請關閉所有電子設備。
He went back to switch off the main power supply.
他折返回去關掉主電源。

items.colloc: adjust the table lamp 調整桌燈 | buy a new table lamp 購買新桌燈
items.distinct: desk lamp 檯燈 | floor lamp 立燈
ex: The table lamp provides soft light for my work.
這盞桌燈為我的工作提供了柔和的光線。
I need a brighter table lamp for reading documents.
我需要一盞更亮的桌燈來閱讀文件。
She placed the table lamp on the corner of the desk.
她把桌燈放在書桌的角落。

items.colloc: make a telephone call 打電話 | receive a telephone call 接到電話
items.distinct: phone call 電話 | conference call 電話會議
ex: I received a telephone call from the regional manager.
我接到了區域經理的電話。
Please hold for a brief telephone call regarding the contract.
請稍候，有一通關於合約的電話。
He is currently busy on a telephone call with clients.
他目前正忙著與客戶通話。

items.colloc: think of a solution 想出解決方案 | think of you 想到你
items.distinct: think about 考慮（持續思考） | come up with 想出（創意）
ex: Can you think of a better way to organize the files?
你能想到整理檔案更好的方法嗎？
I often think of ways to improve our service quality.
我常思考如何提升我們的服務品質。
What do you think of the new marketing strategy?
你覺得新的行銷策略如何？

items.colloc: turn off the engine 關掉引擎 | turn off the tap 關上水龍頭
items.distinct: switch off 關掉（開關） | shut down 關機（系統）
ex: Please turn off the projector after the presentation ends.
簡報結束後請關掉投影機。
Did you turn off the air conditioner in the meeting room?
你有關掉會議室的冷氣嗎？
We should turn off the lights to save on electricity.
我們應該關燈來節省電力。

items.colloc: write down the instructions 寫下指示 | write down the details 記錄細節
items.distinct: take notes 做筆記 | record 錄音/記錄
ex: Please write down your contact information on this form.
請在這份表格上寫下您的聯絡資訊。
I will write down the important points of the meeting.
我會把會議重點記錄下來。
Did you write down the address before leaving the shop?
離開商店前你有把地址記下來嗎？

items.colloc: reply as soon as possible 儘快回覆 | process as soon as possible 儘快處理
items.distinct: at your earliest convenience 儘快（禮貌用語） | immediately 立刻
ex: Please send the revised proposal as soon as possible.
請儘快寄出修訂後的提案。
We need to address the customer complaint as soon as possible.
我們需要儘快處理顧客的投訴。
The manager asked for the report as soon as possible.
經理要求儘快拿到報告。

items.colloc: at this point in time 此時此刻 | at this point of the project 專案的這個階段
items.distinct: at the moment 此時 | currently 目前
ex: At this point, we cannot confirm the shipment date.
目前我們還無法確認出貨日期。
Everything seems to be working well at this point.
目前為止一切運作順利。
We have no further comments to make at this point.
我們目前沒有其他評論。

items.colloc: set up automatic payment 設定自動付款 | cancel automatic payment 取消自動付款
items.distinct: manual payment 手動付款 | online payment 線上付款
ex: You can set up automatic payment for your monthly bills.
你可以為每月帳單設定自動付款。
The service requires automatic payment via a credit card.
這項服務需要透過信用卡自動付款。
I prefer automatic payment to avoid late fees.
我比較喜歡自動付款以避免逾期費用。

items.colloc: be filled with excitement 充滿興奮 | be filled with documents 裝滿文件
items.distinct: full of 充滿（形容詞） | pack with 塞滿
ex: The conference room was filled with eager participants.
會議室裡擠滿了熱切的與會者。
His schedule is filled with back-to-back meetings today.
他今天的行程排滿了連續的會議。
The inbox was filled with inquiries from potential clients.
收件匣裡充滿了潛在客戶的詢問。

items.colloc: be open for business daily 每日營業 | officially be open for business 正式開業
items.distinct: open hours 營業時間 | closed for business 停止營業
ex: The new store will be open for business next Monday.
新店將於下週一正式開業。
We are happy to announce that we are now open for business.
我們很高興地宣布我們現在開始營業了。
The cafe will be open for business until nine tonight.
這家咖啡廳今晚將營業至九點。

items.colloc: belong to the company 屬於公司 | belong to the association 屬於協會
items.distinct: own 擁有 | member of 會員
ex: Does this equipment belong to the maintenance department?
這台設備是屬於維修部的嗎？
The laptop belongs to the marketing team leader.
這台筆記型電腦屬於行銷部組長。
This project does not belong to my current department.
這個專案不屬於我目前的部門。

items.colloc: bend over to pick up 彎腰撿起 | bend over backward 竭盡全力
items.distinct: lean over 傾身 | crouch 蹲下
ex: He had to bend over to retrieve the fallen files.
他必須彎腰去撿起掉落的文件。
Please do not bend over too quickly if you feel dizzy.
如果您感到頭暈，請不要動作太快地彎腰。
She bent over to examine the bottom shelf of the display.
她彎下腰去檢查展示架的最底層。
